verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms a live llms.txt at developer.box.com (HTTP 200, structured 'Box Dev Docs' index), and the evidence also shows agent-oriented markdown renditions of doc pages (e.g., /_llms/en/home.md, agent-configurator.md) that an agent can be pointed at directly. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of agents successfully using these docs, and evidence of a complete llms-full.txt-style bundle.
